title: On the Dot
about: Studio Wood is a bespoke furniture studio whose work has shown at 28 North 77 East and been written up in Architectural Digest and ArchDaily. I conceptualised and helped produce On the Dot, one of its collections — playful, function-first pieces in ashwood veneer and mild steel, including Disco, a statement cabinet built to declutter the TV-viewing experience; Plank, a multifunctional storage piece with a green surprise; Sliver, a coffee table that assembles in seconds; and Connect 2.0, a sleek metal-and-fabric chair.
